item.title: azure: Public Preview: Azure Route Server dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 support
item.description:
Azure Route Server now supports IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack mode in public preview. It enables route exchange for both address families over supported hybrid networking connections, while existing IPv4 connections remain unchanged.

  • Source: Azure Updates
